item.description:
## Enum Reference

### OnboardingTemplateType

| Value | Used In Tab | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DEMOGRAPHICS` | Demographics | The core employee info form. One per system. |
| `POLICY` | Policies | Policy documents that require acknowledgement. |
| `GOVERNMENT_FORM` | Forms | Federal/state government forms (I-9, W-4, Local Tax). |
| `DEFAULT_FORM` | Forms | Custom agency-created forms. |
| `AGENCY_FORM` | Forms | Agency-specific forms (e.g., orientation checklists). |
| `ONBOARDING_QUESTION` | Forms | Conditional question sets that drive task resolution. |
| `DOCUMENT_REQUIREMENT` | Documents | Document upload requirements per employee. |
| `REFERENCE` | References | Reference check templates. Referee contacts are collected inline on the Demographics tab and invites dispatch automatically when demographics submits. |

> 

**typesWithoutConfig** (cannot have a `config` field): `DEMOGRAPHICS`, `AGENCY_FORM`, `GOVERNMENT_FORM`
